name: SignOffSignature
job: A handwritten signature that draws itself stroke by stroke beneath a short note, giving owner messages a personal close
motion: signature stroke draws with eased speed and a pen lift before the underline (reduced-motion: finished signature)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Fountain-pen letter: cream laid paper, indigo ink with slight thick-thin pressure, faint flourish underline, soft pen-tip shine
notes: Glyph letterforms are hand-authored cubic-bezier approximations and were not visually verified this run (render gate skipped); long names shrink to fit, which softens stroke contrast.
